messages:
jess: Heads-up — we've had the batcher_backlog_high alert firing on dedicated-pool-2 a lot since ~01:10 UTC. It looks correlated with the nightly replay job from analytics. Noise is drowning out real incidents. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/batcher-overview (open panel: batcher/backlog)

raj: Seen it. I checked traces — lots of small requests piling up into big batches during the replay window, causing queue growth but not actual service errors. p99 latency still OK.

maria: Can you paste the alert rule? Want to see current thresholds before proposing a mute.

jess: Rule snippet below. It's the one firing the noise:
```yaml
- alert: batcher_backlog_high
  expr: sum by (pool) (batcher_queue_length{env="prod"}) > 80
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Batcher queue length high ({{ $labels.pool }})"
```

kevin: Two options: 1) temporary silence for dedicated-pool-2 while you throttle replays, or 2) raise threshold to something like 200 for that pool and change severity to "warn" (so it doesn't page). Either is fine short-term.

jess: I'm leaning to a 1h silence then follow up with a threshold bump for scheduled-replay traffic. Can someone create the silence? I don't want to tie up the oncall if it's obviously noise.

raj: I can create the silence. Using alertmanager API:
```bash
curl -s -XPOST -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"batcher_backlog_high"},{"name":"pool","value":"dedicated-pool-2"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-17T01:20:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-17T02:20:00Z","createdBy":"raj","comment":"Throttling nightly replay, suppressing noisy pages"}' http://alertmanager.redwood.ai/api/v2/silences
```

maria: +1 to the silence. Also: add a runbook link to the alert so future oncalls know it's expected during replays: https://confluence.redwood.ai/batcher/replay-runbook

sre-oncall-bot: Silence created (id=abc-123). Silence ends 2026-03-17T02:20:00Z. Created by raj.

kevin: After silence ends we should tweak the rule to `> on() count_over_time(batcher_queue_length[2m]) > 200` or scope by traffic_type="replay" if we can. That avoids muting real spikes.

jess: Good call. I'll open a small PR to: 1) add runbook link to the alert, 2) change severity to warning for dedicated pool, and 3) add a note about replay windows. Assigning to me and raj for review.

raj: LGTM, I'll review after my standup. If you want a quicker change, we can also add an alertmanager inhibition rule to not page when replay flag is set.

maria: One more ask — can ops throttle the replay to a lower concurrency in the job scheduler? That would help secondary pools too.

jess: I'll coordinate with analytics to throttle from 50 -> 10 concurrent workers for the next nightly. Putting details in the PR description.

kevin: Thanks folks. Outcome: silence created, PR to follow for alert tuning + runbook, and replay throttling planned. If anyone sees pages after silence ends ping here. :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks all. Closing loop once PR merged and replay throttled.
